text:
maya: Heads-up: sketch for handling streaming retries without global resume tokens — lightweight "stream-fragment" tombstones + end-of-stream checksums. Wanted feedback before I RFC.

 devon: interesting. how does this interact with prefix/KV cache and partial responses? @maya

 maya: goal is to let gateway+upstream emit small id'd fragments. each fragment carries X-Fragment-Id, optional X-Tombstone (if we know fragment was replaced), and an X-Stream-Checksum at EoS. Gateway can replay or scrub fragments based on tombstones.

 arjun: main concern is side-effects. If upstream has side-effects per fragment we need an idempotency-key that survives retries. Proposal: require client to send `Idempotency-Key` for operations that mutate state.

 sam: sounds heavier than current model. what's the runtime overhead? will we hold fragments in memory for minutes?

 devon: also ordering — what if fragments arrive out of order from upstream replicas? we need a merge rule.

 maya: answers: 1) memory: fragments are tiny (256B-8KB), TTLed per-request (default 30s). 2) ordering: fragments are monotonic ints; gateway stitches by id, holes cause backpressure. replica reorders handled by upstream with sequence enforcement or by gateway buffering small window. 3) side-effects: Idempotency-Key + server-side dedupe table; tombstone marks replace older fragment payloads.

 maya: example headers:
 ```http
 X-Fragment-Id: 17
 X-Tombstone: false
 X-Resume-Allowed: 1
 Idempotency-Key: 6b9f-... 
 ```

 infra-bot: spike doc uploaded: https://redwood.internal/notes/stream-fragment-tombstones (PR #4321)

 arjun: API surface note — clients need to include fragment support only when they want retryable streaming; default behaviour unchanged. we should add a feature-flag on the gateway to opt-in per-route.

 maya: ok. next steps: I'll draft a short RFC with failure-mode matrix (partial fragments, tombstone loss, checksum mismatch). Volunteers for a 2-day spike to implement end-to-end sim? @devon @sam

 devon: can take the gateway side.

 sam: i'll prototype a small upstream shim.

 maya: thanks — I'll ping when the RFC is up. :thumbsup:
